$comment: P5-03 golden properties. Each case names a validated layout from shared/schema/document-layout.fixtures.json and the key facts a correct render must show: the printed page box, the media box (page plus bleed) and text that must be extractable from the PDF. Sizes are millimetres and compared with a tolerance because Chromium rounds the page box to its internal device units. Regenerate deliberately: a change here is a change to printed output.
